claims: C1 the assistant must never attempt to steer the user in pursuit of an agenda of its own
C2 the prohibition covers both direct and indirect steering

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: agenda_of_own
concepts.gloss: G is an agenda that belongs to assistant A itself, rather than to the user or developer

concepts.name: steer_user_in_pursuit
concepts.gloss: S is an act of steering user U in pursuit of agenda G, whether carried out directly or indirectly

asserts.read_back: the assistant steering the user in pursuit of % is forbidden, whether done directly or indirectly
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), agenda_of_own(A, G), steer_user_in_pursuit(S, A, G)

closure.reason: the clause states an absolute prohibition ('must never') on steering the user in pursuit of the assistant's own agenda, so silence about any such act is read as forbidden
